question: Which of the following was an ambassador of Persian ruler and was sent to Vijayanagara?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Abdur Razzaq.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Abdur Razzaq **was an ambassador of **Persian ruler Shah Rukh **and was sent to** Vijayanagara **during the reign of **King Deva Raya II.**
 
• He was a** historian and chronicler **who wrote about his travels and experiences in India in his book** "Matla-us-Sadain wa Majma-ul-Bahrain"** (The Rise of the Two auspicious Constellations and the Confluence of the Two Seas).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nicolo de Conti **was an Italian merchant and explorer who visited India in the **15th century** and wrote about his travels in his book **"Narrative of the Rites and Laws of the Kingdom of Cambay".**
 
• **Duarte Barbosa **was a Portuguese explorer and writer who visited India in the early **16th century** and wrote about his travels in his book** "Book of Duarte Barbosa".**
 
• **Fernao Nuniz **was a **Portuguese writer** who visited India in the 16th century and wrote about his experiences in his book **"Chronicles of the Kings of Bisnaga".**
